# Transporeon: API for Visibility

- **Product:** Transporeon: API for Visibility (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** HTTP basic or bearer. Declared security schemes: BasicAuth, BearerAuth.
- **Access:** Transporeon Visibility customers.
- **To call it you would need:** Transporeon Visibility credentials for api.transporeon.com/rtv/v1; returns live vehicle positions, which are personal data for drivers.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.transporeon.com/rtv/v1`, `https://api.test.transporeon.com/rtv/v1`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/sixfold-tp-api-gateway-v1-documentation-api-yaml](https://api.sixfold.com/tp-api-gateway/v1/documentation/api.yaml) (Visibility API specification, version 0.11.0). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/27230553/API+for+Visibility.

## Allocate a vehicle to a transport

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DELETE` | `/transports/{identifier_type}/{identifier_value}/allocation` | `reference` | Clear allocations | identifier_type* (path); identifier_value* (path) |
| `GET` | `/transports/{identifier_type}/{identifier_value}/allocation` | `reference` | Get vehicle allocated to the transport | identifier_type* (path); identifier_value* (path) |
| `POST` | `/transports/{identifier_type}/{identifier_value}/allocation` | `reference` | Allocate a vehicle or mobile phone to a transport | identifier_type* (path); identifier_value* (path); body: application/json |
| `POST` | `/transports/{identifier_type}/{identifier_value}/deallocation` | `reference` | Deallocate a vehicle from a transport | identifier_type* (path); identifier_value* (path) |
